ns2:section.sectionText: FR 576 is a graduate level course and will be an in-depth study of the Guadeloupian author Maryse Condé, starting with her first novel Heremakhonon (1976) and proceeding chronologically until co-authored manifesto Pour une littérature-monde (2007). We will analyze her writings in the area of theory, theater, novel and auto/biography. Additionally we will consider the role played by colonization and the subsequent post-colonial era, and its influence on her writing. Readings are in French and the course will be conducted in French. This course is reading intensive.
